notes.title: Harari's account: Homo sapiens lived as foragers for most of its history; the agricultural revolution began about 12,000
notes.text: Harari's account: Homo sapiens lived as foragers for most of its history; the agricultural revolution began about 12,000 years ago, and he argues it domesticated its farmers as much as they domesticated wheat. Recalled from the recorder's training knowledge; the cited source was not consulted in this session.

source.citation: Yuval Noah Harari, Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind (English edition, Harvill Secker, 2014), part two

notes.text: The car maker whose Swindon plant stood on the former South Marston airfield announced in February 2019 that it would close the plant in 2021; production ended at the end of July 2021. source.citation: Contemporaneous reporting, e.g. BBC News, 19 February 2019 and July 2021

notes.title: The Avebury henge and stone circles were built by Neolithic communities between about 2850 and 2200 BC; the Windmill Hil
notes.text: The Avebury henge and stone circles were built by Neolithic communities between about 2850 and 2200 BC; the Windmill Hill causewayed enclosure nearby dates from about 3700 BC; the Ridgeway has been used as a route for at least five thousand years. Recalled from the recorder's training knowledge; the cited source was not consulted in this session.

source.citation: Historic England and the heritage trust's guidebooks to Avebury; the Stonehenge and Avebury World Heritage Site management plan

notes.title: An algorithmic dollar stablecoin that kept its peg through mint-and-burn arbitrage with a sister token, and whose saving
notes.text: An algorithmic dollar stablecoin that kept its peg through mint-and-burn arbitrage with a sister token, and whose savings protocol paid about 19.5 percent, lost its peg from 9 May 2022; the sister token collapsed to almost nothing by 13 May, and the stablecoin traded around 10-20 cents that day and one or two cents weeks later. Protocol, token and founder stay unnamed or invented in the story. Recalled from the recorder's training knowledge; the cited source was not consulted in this session.

source.citation: Contemporaneous reporting and on-chain price histories, 7-13 May 2022 and after

notes.text: The first cryptocurrency was described in a paper published on 31 October 2008 during the banking crisis; its first block, mined on 3 January 2009, carried a newspaper headline about a second bank bailout.
